deviations.what: Block->content inlining (app 161/178 precedent, CAPABILITIES 'Custom BlockBase blocks in a sap.uxap.ObjectPageLayout'): the blocks aggregations hold SharedBlocks BlockBase controls - blockcolor:BlockBlue (7 times) and blockcolor:BlockBlueWithInfo (once), xmlns:blockcolor='sap.uxap.sample.SharedBlocks'. A BlockBase is only a lazy-loading wrapper around a static view: BlockBlue's view is a single coloured div (html:div style='height:4em; background-color: #A9EAFF ;'), BlockBlueWithInfo's view is a coloured div wrapping an html:a 'ShowSubsectionMore = true', an html:br and an empty m:Text id='moreContentText'. Since ObjectPageSubSection.blocks accepts any sap.ui.core.Control, each block is inlined as a core:HTML leaf carrying the decoded div markup in its content attribute, plus one m:Text leaf for the WithInfo block. Absent as a result: the seven blockcolor:BlockBlue controls with their columnLayout attributes ('auto'/'1'/'1'/'2'/'3'/'3'/'3'), the blockcolor:BlockBlueWithInfo control with its showSubSectionMore='true' and columnLayout='2' attributes, and the block views' own mvc:View roots (they carry only xmlns declarations and their controllerName - no width/height attributes). Present in their place: eight core:HTML controls (content attribute) and one m:Text (id attribute). Typed IMPROVISED since 2026-08-23. CAPABILITIES' own row says "Declare the block→content substitution (IMPROVISED)", and the recipe's refinement is explicit that removing a control the original declares - even a zero-visual-output one - is a loss regardless of a pixel-identical render. 26 of the 31 sidecars citing that row carried NOTE, which hid a measurable loss: columnLayout is honoured only for a real BlockBase instance, so an inlined form falls back to automatic column assignment, and the block ids and view roots go with it.

The BlockBase-specific behaviours are lost with the dropped block controls: (a) columnLayout ('auto'/'1'/'2'/'3') is a BlockBase property telling the ObjectPageSubSection grid how many columns a block spans - core:HTML has no such property, so the three subsections render every inlined block at the default column span instead of the 1/2/3-column arrangements their titles describe; (b) showSubSectionMore='true' on blockcolor:BlockBlueWithInfo (the subsection's 'See more' toggle switching the block into its Expanded view) is dropped, and with it the BlockBase view-mode machinery: the block controller's onAfterRendering fills m:Text id='moreContentText' with '...More Content' only in Expanded mode, so the port's m:Text stays permanently empty (the original's initial Collapsed state) and sits as a sibling after its core:HTML div instead of inside it - a control cannot be wrapped by core:HTML markup, which carries markup in a string attribute only (app 239 precedent).

Named-model prefix-drop (app 230/261 precedent): the controller's ConfigModel (JSONModel {subSectionLayout: 'TitleOnTop'}) is folded onto the one default model - subSectionLayout='{ConfigModel>/subSectionLayout}' becomes the two-way bound root field ({/SUBSECTIONLAYOUT}), seeded 'TitleOnTop' exactly as onInit does. Same leaf name, same data, renders identically. The controller's toggleTitle handler becomes the TOGGLE_TITLE event branch flipping the field between TitleOnTop and TitleOnLeft; the press='.toggleTitle' wire on the ObjectPageHeaderActionButton is client->_event('TOGGLE_TITLE').

Round-trip behaviour not verified in a running system: the 'toggle title' ObjectPageHeaderActionButton fires TOGGLE_TITLE, the backend flips subsectionlayout between TitleOnTop and TitleOnLeft and pushes it back on the round-trip - whether the bound subSectionLayout property re-layouts the subsection titles live, and the overall ObjectPage rendering of the eight inlined core:HTML blocks, remain to be checked. **e2e-verified 2026-08-21** (nightly e2e interaction, meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_408.mjs).
